description: Unit tests for quic stream priority classes and functions in the quiche project, including tests for HttpStreamPriority, WebTransportStreamPriority, QuicStreamPriority, and priority serialization/parsing.

classes.name: HttpStreamPriority
classes.description: Represents the priority of an HTTP stream, including urgency and incremental flag.

classes.name: WebTransportStreamPriority
classes.description: Represents the priority of a WebTransport stream, including stream type and send order.

classes.name: QuicStreamPriority
classes.description: Encapsulates stream priority with support for different priority types (HTTP, WebTransport).

methods.name: SerializePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Serializes stream priority into a string suitable for HTTP header fields.

methods.name: ParsePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Parses a string from HTTP headers into a stream priority object.
